title: MLOPS↔FE-001: Model Deployment-Status & Drift Dashboard Data + Frontend Monitoring Requirements (DERIVED)
description: DERIVED / PROVISIONAL — there is NO direct §6 contract on either the MLOps Engineer or the Frontend/Dashboard Engineer side (MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no Frontend; FRONTEND_DASHBOARD_ENGINEER_SKILL §6 lists no MLOps). Deployment-status and drift dashboards are mediated: MLOps fleet/deployment data reaches the dashboard through the Backend (MLOPS↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001), while the operator-facing inference confidence/drift signal schema is owned by ML↔FE-001. This schema reconstructs the plausible direct interface (deployment-status / drift dashboard data ↔ frontend monitoring requirements) for machine validation; per its x-macp.source_status it mandates a COUNTER. Drift surfacing maps to FC-022 (erosion-shaped detection).

mlops_dashboard_data.description: MLOPS→FE: deployment-status + drift-monitoring data for dashboards (served via MLOPS↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001).

drift_monitoring_data.description: Erosion-shaped drift series for dashboards (FC-022); each carries a unit.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Provisional/DERIVED edge — no §6 contract exists on either side; deployment-status and drift dashboards are served through the Backend (MLOPS↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001), and the inference confidence/drift signal schema is owned by ML↔FE-001. Agents coordinate provisionally and must COUNTER for ratification.

mediation.rationale: No direct contract needed: MLOps fleet/deployment data reaches dashboards through the Backend (MLOPS↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001), and the operator-facing inference confidence/drift signal schema is the already-ratified ML↔FE-001; a direct MLOPS↔FE contract would add only redundancy (no FC-022 detection coverage).

x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (provisional — to be set by the ratifying §6 contract / CCR)
confirm_conditions: fleet device counts, drift values, and refresh rate carry explicit units
deployment-status / drift data reaches the dashboard via the Backend (MLOPS↔BACK-001 → BACK↔FE-001)
the operator-facing confidence/drift signal schema defers to ML↔FE-001
reject_conditions: a device-count, drift, or refresh-rate quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a drift value softened below its computed value to suppress a dashboard alert (Honesty Over Polish §10.3; FC-022)
this DERIVED schema treated as a binding contract — it is provisional pending §6 ratification
counter_conditions: ALWAYS COUNTER: request ratification of a real MLOPS↔FE §6 contract (or confirm it is intentionally mediated via Backend) via a CCR before any binding CONFIRM
a drift dashboard needs the inference confidence/drift signal schema — source it from ML↔FE-001, not redefined here
